senses.definition: n.pr.mont. near Hermon, הַר מ׳ ψ 42:7 mt. (of) Miṣʿar (perhaps orig. littleness), not identified; so De Now Du Dr GASmGeogr. 477; others mt. of littleness, little mt., so 𝔊 𝔙 Hi Che Bae We al. (interpr. then usually of Zion).
